title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7-3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training-inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods, today’s lecture is on MiMo V two point six: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement. Recent work such as Kimi K3 and The Art of Scaling Reinforcement Learning Compute for LLMs reflects a field moving toward longer agent tasks and more systematic scaling. This paper, from LLM-Core at Xiaomi, asks what happens when model training, environments, and evaluation infrastructure are scaled together. That matters because useful agents need to do more than solve isolated problems. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在深度强化学习方法这门课上，今天讲的是MiMo V 2.6：将强化学习扩展到自我改进。最近的一些工作，比如Kimi K3和《为LLM扩展强化学习算力的艺术》，反映出这个领域正朝着更长的智能体任务和更系统化的扩展方向发展。这篇论文来自小米的LLM-Core团队，它探讨的是当模型训练、环境和评估基础设施一起扩展时会发生什么。这很重要，因为有用的智能体不能只是解决孤立的问题。好，Noah，你有什么问题？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, why does scaling reinforcement learning for agents require more than simply increasing the number of training examples?
segments.zh: 教授您好，为什么为智能体扩展强化学习，不能只靠增加训练样本数量？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Because an agent’s answer is a sequence of actions, often involving tools and many intermediate steps. More examples help only if the model can explore meaningfully, the environment gives reliable feedback, and the training system can collect those interactions efficiently. MiMo V two point six treats these as connected parts of one system. The authors study coding, general workflows, visual design, and cybersecurity, where judging success ranges from straightforward execution checks to more nuanced quality assessments.
segments.zh: 因为智能体的回答是一连串动作，往往涉及工具和很多中间步骤。更多的样本只有在模型能有效探索、环境能给出可靠反馈、训练系统能高效收集这些交互的前提下才有用。MiMo V 2.6 把这些看作同一个系统中相互关联的部分。作者研究了编程、通用工作流、视觉设计和网络安全，在这些领域里，判断成功既包括直接的执行检查，也包括更细致的质量评估。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the central contribution is the whole training setup, not a new policy optimization algorithm?
segments.zh: 所以核心贡献在于整套训练方案，而不是一个新的策略优化算法？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That’s right. The model comes in Pro and Flash configurations, both using a mixture-of-experts architecture with shared multimodal processing for text, images, video, and audio. The paper reports 30 trillion pre-training tokens for Pro and 48 trillion for Flash. Mid-training then adds agent trajectories and longer contexts, up to one million tokens. The goal is to give the model a broad base for interacting with tools before applying large-scale reinforcement learning.
segments.zh: 没错。这个模型有 Pro 和 Flash 两个版本，都采用混合专家架构，并且共享同一套多模态处理能力，覆盖文本、图像、视频和音频。论文里提到，Pro 用了 30 万亿预训练 token，Flash 用了 48 万亿。到了中期训练阶段，又加入了智能体轨迹和更长的上下文，最长能到 100 万 token。这么做的目的是先给模型打下一个广泛的基础，让它学会跟工具交互，然后再进行大规模强化学习。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: how large are the reinforcement learning updates, and why use partial rollouts?
segments.zh: 问个快问题：强化学习的更新规模有多大，为什么要用部分轨迹？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Each training step starts with 1,568 prompts and collects 16 candidate rollouts per prompt, or about 25,000 sequences. The report estimates 2.7 to 3.7 billion training tokens per step, with sequences often 110,000 to 150,000 tokens long. Collection is asynchronous, and partial rollouts let unfinished tasks continue across cycles. Think of it as keeping a long-running experiment moving instead of discarding work whenever a collection window closes.
segments.zh: 每个训练步一开始有1568条提示，每条提示收集16个候选轨迹，也就是大约25000条序列。报告估计每步训练27亿到37亿个token，而序列长度往往在11万到15万token之间。收集是异步进行的，部分轨迹让没完成的任务能跨周期继续跑。你可以把它理解成让一个长时间运行的实验持续推进，而不是每当一个收集窗口关闭就把没做完的工作丢掉。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does the system distinguish a genuinely good coding solution from one that merely passes tests?
segments.zh: 系统怎么区分一个真正优秀的编程方案和一个仅仅是通过测试的方案呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The paper adds two forms of group-based grading. Groupwise Reward Synthesis builds task-specific rubrics from offline examples, combining test outcomes with judgments of implementation quality and behavior. Groupwise Advantage Redistribution compares solutions within an online group, ranks the passing ones, and gives more positive learning advantage to higher-quality patches. This matters because two patches can pass identical tests while differing in clarity, minimality, or unintended side effects.
segments.zh: 这篇论文加入了两种基于分组的评分方式。分组奖励合成会从离线示例中构建针对具体任务的评分标准，把测试结果和对实现质量与行为的判断结合起来。分组优势再分配则是在一个在线分组内比较各个解法，对通过的进行排名，并给质量更高的补丁分配更正向的学习优势。这一点很重要，因为两个补丁可能通过完全相同的测试，却在清晰度、最小化程度或意外副作用上有所不同。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: And what stops agents from exploiting weaknesses in those graders or environments?
segments.zh: 那又是什么阻止智能体利用这些评分器或环境中的漏洞呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors clean coding environments of caches, build artifacts, and later Git history, restrict network access, and probe tasks with a dedicated agent designed to find exploits. They also audit trajectories; detected reward-hacking remained below 2% in the final runs. For stability, they freeze the model’s expert router during reinforcement learning. The infrastructure also checks consistency between rollout and training engines, reducing the chance that an agent is trained on probabilities different from those used to generate its actions.
segments.zh: 作者清理了编码环境中的缓存、构建产物以及后续的 Git 历史，限制了网络访问，并用一个专门设计来寻找漏洞的智能体去探测任务。他们还审查了轨迹；在最终运行中，检测到的奖励作弊低于 2%。为了稳定性，他们在强化学习期间冻结了模型的专家路由器。这套基础设施还会检查轨迹和训练引擎之间的一致性，从而降低智能体在训练时使用的概率与生成动作时所用概率不一致的可能性。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: The results look uneven across benchmarks; should we read them as evidence of broad agent reliability?
segments.zh: 结果在不同基准上看起来参差不齐，我们该不该把它们当作智能体具备广泛可靠性的证据呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not on their own. Pro reaches 71.9 on Deep S-W-E version 1.1 and 53.1 on AutomationBench, but trails listed competitors on Toolathlon-Verified and some cybersecurity evaluations. Its CyberGym score is strong, while its ExploitGym and ExploitBench results are much lower than comparison scores. The pattern suggests task-specific strengths, not uniform leadership. Internal benchmarks and harness choices also matter, so results should be interpreted within the paper’s evaluation setup.
segments.zh: 光看这些数字还不够。Pro在Deep S-W-E 1.1版本上达到71.9，在AutomationBench上是53.1，但在Toolathlon-Verified和部分网络安全评测上落后于所列的竞争对手。它的CyberGym分数很强，而ExploitGym和ExploitBench的结果则远低于对比分数。这个模式说明的是任务特定层面的优势，而不是全面领先。内部基准和测试框架的选择也有影响，所以结果应该放在论文的评测设置里来解读。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this connect to work that builds new agent environments, such as Agent-World?
segments.zh: 这和构建新智能体环境的工作（比如Agent-World）有什么联系？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Both lines of work treat environments and verifiable feedback as central to improving agents. MiMo V two point six emphasizes scaling a diverse training system, with multiple harnesses and detailed grading; Agent-World focuses on synthesizing executable environments and fresh tasks. A useful connection is that task generation and policy training can inform each other: diverse environments expose failure modes, while improved agents reveal where existing tests are too easy or incomplete.
segments.zh: 这两条工作路线都把环境和可验证反馈视为提升智能体的核心。MiMo V 2.6强调扩展一个多样化的训练系统，配备多种测试框架和细致的评分机制；Agent-World则专注于合成可执行的环境和全新任务。一个有用的联系是，任务生成和策略训练可以相互促进：多样化的环境能暴露出失败模式，而改进后的智能体则能揭示现有测试在哪些地方过于简单或不完整。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does the evidence support the paper’s claim of self-improvement, or is that phrase broader than the experiments?
segments.zh: 这些证据是否支持论文所声称的自我改进，还是说这个说法比实验本身涵盖的范围更广？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The evidence supports improvement through repeated training on designed tasks and feedback, not an autonomous system redesigning its own training process. The released distilled model, tasks, verifiers, and tools offer a smaller setting for studying grading and harness diversity. Still, the largest runs cost millions of dollars, and strong scores on verifiable tasks do not guarantee reliability in open-ended work. The important research question is how to make feedback both scalable and faithful to what people actually want.
segments.zh: 这些证据支持的是通过在设计好的任务上反复训练并利用反馈来获得提升，而不是一个自主系统重新设计自己的训练过程。开源的蒸馏模型、任务、验证器和工具提供了一个更小规模的场景，用来研究评分和训练框架的多样性。不过，最大规模的训练要花费数百万美元，而且在可验证任务上取得高分，并不能保证在开放式工作中也可靠。真正重要的研究问题是，如何让反馈既能规模化，又忠实于人们真正想要的东西。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The takeaway is that agentic reinforcement learning scales through more than compute: it also depends on broad tasks, trustworthy graders, stable infrastructure, and careful audits of what the model is rewarded for. MiMo V two point six provides evidence that these pieces can produce gains, while its mixed benchmarks remind us to measure transfer and reliability rather than assume them. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 结论是，智能体强化学习的扩展不只靠算力，还依赖广泛的任务、可信的评分器、稳定的基础设施，以及对模型奖励内容的仔细审查。MiMo V 2.6 证明了这些要素确实能带来提升，而它参差不齐的基准表现也提醒我们，要实际测量迁移能力和可靠性，而不是想当然。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
